## Kicks Only

A cook's hands are for cooking. Red-Leg Zeff fought with his feet so he would never ruin them, and taught Sanji the same.

Fight in the Black Leg style and unlock the Anti-Manner Kick Course.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Fight as a Black Leg](st_black_leg.md#q-755cf46711746ec7)

**Tasks**

- Unlock Anti-Manner Kick Course

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +5 Training Points (your style)

## Diable Jambe

Spin fast enough and the leg catches fire. Sanji found that out at Enies Lobby.

Unlock Diable Jambe, Land on a harbor town in East Blue and reach 20,000 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Sky Walk](st_black_leg.md#q-25c14dcde0cdf838)

**Tasks**

- Unlock Diable Jambe
- Land on a harbor town in East Blue
- Reach 20,000 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +60,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +12 Training Points (your style)
